title: Zendesk Sell Review (2026)
intro: Zendesk Sell sales CRM with Team through Enterprise annual per-agent plans for pipeline and sales engagement. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Zendesk Sell overall score 6.8/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Zendesk Sell annual: Team $19, Growth $55, Professional $115, Enterprise $169 per agent/mo.
verdict: Zendesk Sell: Choose Zendesk Sell when Zendesk CX alignment and published Sell tiers matter. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.

sections.heading: Pros and cons
sections.body: Pros: Published Team–Enterprise Sell pricing; Zendesk ecosystem integrations; Sales pipeline + engagement tooling. Cons: Price jumps across tiers; Sell vs Support packaging complexity; Value-for-money weaker without Zendesk stack.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
